rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Thirty-eight percent of rejected agent PRs received no meaningful human review.
rationale.quality-debt: Mined PRs exhibit CI failures and incorrect or incomplete implementations.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Repository CI and tests materially distinguish merged from rejected agentic PRs.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Maintainers gate merges through review comments, revisions, rejection, and acceptance.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Agents implement unwanted changes and repeatedly disregard explicit reviewer instructions.
rationale.agentic: Study examines autonomous agents submitting artifact-scale pull requests.
rationale.risk-quality: Empirically measures CI failures, invasive changes, and implementation defects.
rationale.risk-ip: Taxonomy reports licensing and ownership failures in agent-generated contributions.
rationale.method-mining: Analyzes 33,596 GitHub PRs and manually codes 600 rejected artifacts.
